name: Live Collab
tagline: Share a note and edit it together, live
description: Work on the same note with other people at the same time, like Google Docs: you see their cursors and selections with their names, and their typing appears as they type.
author: Granite
setup: Switch the plugin on (Plugins → Installed), then open the note you want to work on.
Press Share at the top right of the note, then Start sharing. The first time, type your name in the ⚙ settings of that window if you like: others see it next to your cursor.
Press Copy link and send the link to your friend. Anyone who has it can read and edit the note, so send it only to people you trust.
Your friend installs Live Collab too, presses Share, pastes the link under “Join someone else's note” and presses Join. It opens as a new note on their side.
Both of you need an up-to-date Granite (plugin API 7). To stop, press Share → Leave the live session.
Optional: to use your own relay server instead of Granite's, put its wss:// address in the ⚙ settings of the Share window (the plugin's README says how to run one).
